system.name: Streamly · studio study
system.description: Separate playback, platform API and media/event workers with private storage, C3 queues, search, cache and optional CDN identity.

nodes.name: Viewer
nodes.description: Discovers and watches public video; signs in for subscriptions.

nodes.name: Creator

nodes.name: Trust & safety staff
nodes.description: Reviews reports and records accountable moderation decisions.

nodes.name: Media delivery provider
nodes.description: An external CDN serves immutable segments and enforces short-lived access grants.

nodes.description: External login and token issuance for viewers, creators and staff.

nodes.name: Email provider
nodes.description: Delivers creator processing outcomes and moderation notices.

elements.name: Viewer & creator web
elements.description: Discovery, watch pages, channel management and resumable creator uploads.

elements.name: Trust & safety console
elements.description: Staff review reports, suspend content and inspect an audited moderation history.

elements.name: Platform API
elements.description: A modular application owns channels, video metadata, upload sessions and moderation decisions.

elements.name: Playback API
elements.description: Independently scaled read path checks video visibility and issues short-lived media access grants.

elements.name: Media processor
elements.description: Scans originals, creates encoded renditions and records completion before publication.

elements.name: Activity worker
elements.description: Consumes catalog events to update discovery indexes and deliver creator notifications.

elements.name: Catalog database
elements.description: Authoritative channels, access policy, video states, upload sessions and transactional outbox.

elements.name: Playback metadata cache
elements.description: Derived visibility and rendition descriptors with bounded age; the catalog remains authoritative.

elements.name: Original uploads
elements.description: Private quarantine for uploaded source files, addressed by upload identity and checksum.

elements.name: Published renditions
elements.description: Versioned immutable media segments, manifests and thumbnails, restricted to the delivery provider.

elements.name: Media processing jobs
elements.description: Named work queue for durable, duplicate-safe media processing. Broker placement is a later deployment choice.

elements.name: Catalog change events
elements.description: Named channel for publication, visibility changes and removal; retained for consumer replay.

elements.name: Discovery index
elements.description: Rebuildable public-video and channel search documents. Never the authority for playback permission.

elements.name: Media delivery provider
elements.description: An external CDN serves immutable segments and enforces short-lived access grants.

elements.name: Identity provider
elements.description: External login and token issuance for viewers, creators and staff.

elements.name: Email provider
elements.description: Delivers creator processing outcomes and moderation notices.
